description: This Java class defines a command to delete a property from a feature in an IoT or device management context. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON, validating input, and serializing the command, encapsulating the logic for removing a specific property identified by a JSON pointer from a feature of a Thing identified by its ID.

classes.name: DeleteFeatureProperty
classes.description: A command object to delete a specific property from a feature of a Thing, including serialization, deserialization, and validation logic.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of DeleteFeatureProperty with a typed ThingId, feature ID, property pointer, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON string or JSON object, parsing required fields.

methods.name: getPropertyPointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer for the property to be deleted.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing entity.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Constructs and returns the resource path indicating which property to delete.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the command payload into JSON, respecting schema version and predicates.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated headers.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates that this command doesn't change authorization.
